title: Croydon Nocturne
description: A beatless minor-key pad and a hypnotic square arpeggio open into the dark, then a swung 2-step kit and deep rolling sub bass creep in. A chopped soul vocal flickers over off-beat dub chord stabs as filters slowly open and the space widens into reverb and delay.

setcpm(138/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(400,800).slow(8)).room(0.6).gain(0.5),
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).lpf(700).gain(0.5).room(0.4).delay(0.3)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c2 ab1>/2").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(500,1100).slow(8)).room(0.6).gain(0.5),

    s("hh*4").bank("CasioRZ1").gain("0.35 0.5 0.4 0.55").swingBy(0.18,8).pan(perlin.range(0.3,0.7))
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<c1 ab0 eb1 g0>").s("sine").lpf(420).gain(0.85),

    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.45).swingBy(0.2,8).cut(1),
    s("think").chop(8).slice(8,"0 2 1 4 0 5 2 7").speed("<1 1.5 0.5>").crush(7).gain(0.55).room(0.3).delay(".4:.166:.5"),
    n("0 2 4 7 9").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).lpf(perlin.range(900,2400).slow(9)).gain(0.5).delay(0.3).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.35))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("piano").gain(0.5).room(0.6).delay(0.4).vowel("<a e o>"),

    s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ [bd ~]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.95),
    s("~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd ~").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.8).room(0.25).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.45).swingBy(0.2,8).cut(1).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(1.5)),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.5).room(0.3),
    s("think").chop(8).slice(8,"0 2 1 4 5 3 2 7").speed("<1 1.5 0.5 2>").crush(7).gain(0.55).room(0.3).delay(".4:.166:.5").every(8, x => x.rev()),

    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).lpf(800).gain(0.45).room(0.5).delay(0.4),
